rv.q: With her sultry beauty, precision and flawless line, she literally takes your breath away.
Tango After Dark is a wonderful example of the dance style in its purest and most daring form.
There is no doubting the world-class skills and expertise of the performers – both dancers and musicians – but it presents a seemingly endless agenda of tango duets, each stylistically similar...
Tango After Dark isn't just a polished dance show; it's a living, breathing love letter to Argentine tango.
Passionate, visually impressive and performed with precision, Tango After Dark is well worth seeing.
Acrobatics rule; subtlety not so much, and as for soul, well, that's surely too much to ask for.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this tango revival: some praise the world-class technique and passionate performances, while others find it repetitive and lacking soul, with limited appeal beyond existing tango fans.
